Thank you for the excellent work in the kitchen.
Thank you very much, chef!

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('magnificent, splendid').

examples.trans: A magnificent idea from an unknown person.

examples.text: Муж подарил ей великолепный букет цветов.

meanings.note: возвращаться домой = to come back home; к + dative = to someone

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'молчать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fall silent, shut up', paired with 'молчать'.

examples.trans: Shut up and stop frightening us.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'личный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('excellent').

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'лыбнуться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to smile', paired with 'улыбаться'.

examples.text: Самсон, ну улыбнись. У нас мир.
examples.trans: Samson, come on, smile. We're at peace.

meanings.note: short form чисто: всё чисто = everything is clean

examples.text: Нин, я всё помыл. Всё чисто.
examples.trans: Nina, I washed everything. It's all clean.
